summary: Admit exactly one new top-level docs/guards entry, v4-adoption, for the curated V4 Guards adoption package of IFX; the cutover-preservation allowlist becomes plans, V3, V3_ifx and v4-adoption, compared case-sensitively, and every other entry still fails.
rationale: IFX adopts V4 Guards (from von12549/Guard) alongside V3 during a coexistence window. The V4 trusted inputs (the exact reviewed ifx_profile bundle and its production review, the V4-native evidence producers, the P10.3 aggregate, the proposal and the receipts) need one reviewed location in the protected history that V3 does not own, so that a later pull request can publish them and a V4 workflow can read them from the trusted base. Admitting a single entry keeps the allowlist exact: the lab tree (candidates, inventories, artifacts) and the V4 backlog stay on the development branch and are never admitted. The change is a trusted component change of tcb.validation.package-tests consumed under one change-trusted-base authorization (D10, D15, D23); its assertions only grow: the comparison becomes case-sensitive, and a missing v4-adoption entry fails like any unexpected one. V3 keeps owning every V3 path, workflow and required context; no V3 verdict reads v4-adoption.
